image_description: A light blue ceramic teacup with a floral pattern sits on a matching white saucer on a wooden table. The cup has two small, looped handles on opposite sides (a bouillon or consomme style cup). In the background, there are bright pink flowers and a window.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a vessel with an open top and a tapered cylindrical body.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The right handle appears to merge into the cup body without a distinct, clean attachment point. It looks slightly melted or fused into the floral pattern, lacking the clear geometric separation seen on the left handle.

The floral pattern exhibits slight smearing and inconsistency in resolution compared to the sharpness of the rim. Some flower shapes blend into the background texture rather than sitting distinctly on the surface.
The elliptical curve of the saucer rim shows minor irregularities in thickness and curvature, suggesting slight warping typical of AI generation.
